trial_court: Court of learned Senior Civil Judge, Mangalagiri (HMOP No.46 of 2020)
case_name: Nadella Bhargavi Rachapudi Bhargavi. v. Rachapudi Arun Babu

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: wife, requesting transfer of divorce petition

facts_of_case: Petitioner is wife of respondent; they married in 2019 and have been living separately; petitioner requests transfer of divorce petition from Mangalagiri to Nellore due to distance and personal reasons

legal_principles.principle: A party's residence does not necessarily determine the jurisdiction of a court.
legal_principles.held: When these circumstances are considered, it is apparent that the respondent shall necessarily appear in one of the Courts at Nellore.

legal_principles.principle: A party's ability to attend a court is not necessarily hindered by the distance.
legal_principles.held: According to the petitioner, the respondent would not find it hard to attend the Court at Nellore, once the above divorce petition is transferred as requested by her.

outcome.final_order: Petition is transferred to Family Court, Nellore, for disposal in accordance with law

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
